basic_info.description: Charming Excelsior Home. Nestled in San Franciscos vibrant Excelsior Neighborhood, this bright and inviting home blends comfort and convenience. Inside, the eat-in kitchen shines with light cabinetry and stainless steel appliances, while hardwood floors flow throughout the home, enhancing its warmth and character. Natural light fills every room, including the bathroom, which features a skylight, separate walk-in shower, and soaking tub. The bedrooms overlook the private backyard, an ideal space for outdoor dining, entertaining, or simply relaxing among mature fruit trees and a thriving garden. The oversized garage offers endless possibilitieswhether you envision a family/playroom, home office, fitness area, or just extra storage and parking. Enjoy nearby Crocker Amazon Park for bocce, soccer, or leisurely walks with pets. With Mission Street and Geneva Avenues shops, restaurants, and cafés just minutes awayand easy access to BART and freeways this location is perfect for commuting throughout San Francisco and to Silicon Valley. Built in 1955, this home is ready to welcome its next chapter.
